t: Westferry Circus is a round public space in the Canary Wharf estate, built around a road interchange. It has two roundabouts, one stacked above the other, so traffic circles on two levels. A circus, from the Latin for circle, simply means a round open space at a street junction. The design is by Laurie Olin, an American landscape architect who has worked at every scale, from private gardens to public parks and corporate and museum campuses.
